preregistration.decision_rule: Beneficial sequence-level effect at T=10 or T=20 requires sign consistency >=4/5 seeds and |Cohen's dz| >= 0.8 (conventional large band); net candidate->commit rescue (rescue>regression); no large operation-level regression. Transition-only effect => partial (B).
preregistration.note: Intervention on the full 212-dim gate vector only; recursive rollout; no readout/label information enters the intervention. gamma values fixed before results.

metadata.statistical_discipline: Seeds (5 frozen checkpoints) are independent units; transition-level rescue/regression is descriptive. Paired seed-level inference vs gamma=1.

compute_parity.note: The intervention adds one scalar multiply and one clamp per state coordinate per step; zero trainable parameters; no optimizer; inference only. Cost is negligible relative to the core.

decision_E_primary.rule_note: Pre-registered: A requires a gamma>1 beneficial sign-consistent (>=4/5) large (|dz|>=0.8, p<0.05) sequence-level effect at T10/T20 with net rescue and no large operation regression. B: the local commit mechanism moves causally (margin delivery / net rescue) but with no beneficial sequence-level effect (or mixed). D: harmful sequence-level effect with neither margin nor rescue benefit. C: neither. gamma<1 is the transfer-reduction control.

decision_F_control.rule_note: Pre-registered: A requires a gamma>1 beneficial sign-consistent (>=4/5) large (|dz|>=0.8, p<0.05) sequence-level effect at T10/T20 with net rescue and no large operation regression. B: the local commit mechanism moves causally (margin delivery / net rescue) but with no beneficial sequence-level effect (or mixed). D: harmful sequence-level effect with neither margin nor rescue benefit. C: neither. gamma<1 is the transfer-reduction control.
